title: Saturn ring-system feature row
description: One feature in Saturn's ring system. Covers ring boundaries, gaps, resonance anchors, shepherd moons, and edge structures. The feature_type field discriminates row sub-shape; required fields are the ones every feature shares (name, feature_type, radial_distance_km, source_doi, source_published_date, entered_locally_at). Optional fields are populated where the feature_type and the cited source supply them.

name.description: Catalogued feature name (e.g., 'Cassini Division inner edge', 'Encke Gap', 'Pan', 'F-ring core').

feature_type.description: Feature category. ring_boundary = the inner/outer edge of a named ring (B-ring outer, A-ring outer); ring_gap = a maintained gap inside a ring (Cassini Division, Encke, Keeler); resonance_anchor = a ring location whose existence is sustained by a mean-motion resonance with a satellite; shepherd_moon = a satellite whose orbit gravitationally maintains a ring boundary or gap; ring_edge_structure = scalloped / wavy / azimuthal structure on a ring edge.

radial_distance_km.description: Distance from Saturn's centre, kilometres. Saturn's equatorial radius is 60268 km (1 R_S); the E ring extends past 480000 km. Ring features sit between ~67000 km (D-ring inner edge) and ~480000 km (E-ring outer extent).

width_km.description: Radial width for ring_gap and ring_boundary features. Null for point-like features (resonance_anchor, shepherd_moon).

associated_body.description: For resonance_anchor: the satellite whose mean-motion resonance maintains this feature. For shepherd_moon: the body's own name (redundant with name). For ring_gap: the shepherd body if known (e.g., Pan for Encke).

resonance_p.description: Resonance ratio numerator p in p:q mean-motion resonance. Convention: p:q = (satellite period) : (particle period); for inner Lindblad resonances p > q.

resonance_q.description: Resonance ratio denominator q in p:q mean-motion resonance. See resonance_p for convention.

regime_label.description: Which dynamical regime (notebook §0.0 / §20.4 / v0.24.9 classifier) this row contributes to. Optional but strongly recommended; populated when the row's regime is unambiguous.

source_doi.description: DOI of the peer-reviewed paper or canonical reference authorising this row's numerical values. Required by the literature_curated adapter for per-row attestation. ISBN form acceptable for textbook citations (e.g., 'isbn:978-0521575973' for Murray-Dermott 1999).

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 date when the cited paper / textbook / archive entry was published. Format: 'YYYY' (year only, e.g., '1999' for textbooks where exact issue date doesn't matter), 'YYYY-MM' (year + month for journal issues), or 'YYYY-MM-DD' (full date for online papers). Curator-authored from the cited DOI's metadata. Distinct from attestation.retrieved_at (when the framework processed this row); aligns with Dublin Core dcterms:issued.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was first added to the catalogue or last meaningfully amended. Curator-authored. Lets future MPM auditors trace when the catalogue took its current shape independent of when the underlying papers were published. Aligns with Dublin Core dcterms:dateAccessioned.

source_version.description: Optional. For archives or textbook editions where the version matters (e.g., 'DE441' for an ephemeris kernel; '1st edition' or '2nd edition' for textbook citations; an archive release tag like 'v4.2'). Null for journal papers where the DOI fully resolves the version.

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — historical context, measurement caveats, cross-references to other rows or to the §20.4 dynamical regimes.
